import os
import google.cloud.pubsub_v1 as pubsub_v1

def batch_publish(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project_id = config.get("project_id", os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "default-project"))
    topic_id = config.get("topic_id", "default-topic")
    publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
    topic_path = publisher.topic_path(project_id, topic_id)
    futures = []
    for idx, item in enumerate(payload):
        future = publisher.publish(topic_path, str(item).encode("utf-8"), **{"sequence_id": str(idx)})
        futures.append(future)
    result = [f.result() for f in futures]
    return result
